name: Rebecca Gamboa
office: Regional Superintendent of Schools, DuPage County

items.text: Rebecca Gamboa is a public school teacher with over 29 years of experience who teaches in the Lombard school district. She is the co-president of the Lombard Education Association and a former National Education Association director. Her campaign says she wants to provide flexible professional development and help districts implement the Illinois Human Rights Act. She also proposes seeking solutions for teacher shortages and focusing on open dialogue.
